title: create-objectstack: the scaffolded AGENTS.md "Project Structure" lists src/reports, src/agents, src/i18n and src/handlers, which the config never loads, so metadata an agent puts there is silently ignored and still passes validate
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYVchZUzHRyGz9MiQM

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 公开入口 `os validate` 实测一次错误结果：无效的 report 放在 AGENTS.md 指的目录里，validate 仍然通过）
业务理由: 按官网「Build with Claude Code」走的新手，第一件事是让 coding agent 读 AGENTS.md 再写元数据。AGENTS.md 的目录树告诉 agent 报表放 `src/reports/`、AI agent 放 `src/agents/`、翻译放 `src/i18n/`、钩子放 `src/handlers/`，但脚手架的 `objectstack.config.ts` 不读这四个目录。agent 照做后元数据不加载、`npm run validate` 不检查也不报错，用户在 Console 里找不到东西还以为 AI 写坏了。不修，AI-first 路径的第一份说明书就在把 agent 往死目录里引。
动手的读者: domain:devx 席（create-objectstack），`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md` 的 Project Structure 块（main ff881050 第 62–76 行）：改成模板真正接线的目录（objects/views/actions/flows/dashboards/apps/skills/picklists），并说一句「新目录要在 config 里接线」；可加一条 pin，把这个块和 `templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts` 的 barrel 列表对齐。
查重: `is:issue AGENTS.md "Project Structure"` 3 命中、`is:issue scaffold AGENTS.md directory not wired` 40、`is:issue create-objectstack AGENTS.md handlers` 114（均含已关）。最近邻 #20333（config 只接 objects，已关并修好）、#21018（picklists 接线，已关），都修了 config，没碰 AGENTS.md 的目录树。

QA-source: 18.3.0 wave 4 newcomer first-visit walkthrough (W4-NEWCOMER), path 2 "Build with Claude Code", anchor #27377

## What happens
`npm create objectstack@latest support-desk` (create-objectstack 18.2.0, npm 10.9.9, Node 22.23.4) writes `AGENTS.md` whose "Project Structure" block reads:

```
├── src/
│   ├── objects/ … views/ … apps/ … flows/ … actions/ … dashboards/
│   ├── reports/              # Analytics reports
│   ├── agents/               # AI agent definitions
│   ├── i18n/                 # Translation bundles
│   └── handlers/             # Runtime hook handlers
```

The generated `objectstack.config.ts` imports exactly eight barrels: objects, views, actions, flows, dashboards, apps, skills, picklists. Its own comment says "A directory that is not wired here is never loaded, and `objectstack validate` neither counts nor checks what it holds." So four of the ten listed directories are dead, and two that are wired (skills, picklists) are missing from the list.

## Reproduction
1. `npm create objectstack@latest support-desk && cd support-desk`
2. `mkdir src/reports` and write `src/reports/ticket.report.ts` exporting `{ name: 'tickets_by_status', type: 'nonsense_type', bogus: true }`, plus `src/reports/index.ts` re-exporting it.
3. `npm run validate`

Expected: the report is loaded and refused, or AGENTS.md does not send an agent to `src/reports/`.
Actual: `✓ Validation passed`, counts unchanged (`UI: 1 Apps 1 Views 1 Actions`); the report is never loaded.

Same text on `main` ff881050 (`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/AGENTS.md`).
